title: Oil Infused German Pork Bowl
description: A savory and fluffy German dish featuring yuzu and pork, perfect for a hangover cure, served in a lacquerware bowl. This keto-friendly meal is made using a bain-marie method.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together coconut oil, yuzu juice, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Place the pork shoulder in a lacquerware bowl and brush the oil mixture evenly over the pork.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and place it in a larger bowl filled with hot water to create a bain-marie.
Bake the pork in the preheated oven for 2 hours.
Remove the pork from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Slice the pork into thin strips and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the pork in the lacquerware bowl.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
